reason: Seeing the drawer cash and who is in the chair while I'm at my other work is exactly what I worry about, but nothing here tells me where my customer data lives if a phone breaks or a stylist leaves. And paying ₹4,999 upfront before the free month even proves itself is a lot for a two-chair shop.
objection: If the phone breaks or gets stolen, do I lose all my customer numbers and wallet balances? Customers have prepaid money in that wallet and I can't afford to lose track of it.
would_change_my_mind: A clear promise that everything is saved online and comes back on a new phone, plus letting me pay the ₹4,999 setup only after the free month if I decide to stay.
